newsitem.title: USA: US House subcommittee sees Feb bank reform hearing.
newsitem.headline: US House subcommittee sees Feb bank reform hearing.

text.p: U.S. House Financial Institutions Subcommittee will hold hearings February 11, 13 and 25 on a proposal to reform the financial services sector, subcommittee chairwoman Marge Roukema said on Friday.
The New Jersey Republican said the hearings would cover the general issue of reform as well as a bill she sponsored, the Depository Institution Affiliations and Thrift Charter Conversion Act.
The February 11 hearing will include testimony from a number of financial sector trade groups, including the Indepedent Insurance Agents of America.
The February 13 hearing will include testimony from government agencies, including the Federal Reserve, Treasury Department and Financial Deposit Insurance Corp.
The final hearing, on February 25, will include testimony from consumer groups and former Federal Reserve chairman Paul Volcker.
Each hearing will begin at 1000 EST/1500 GMT in room 2128 of the Rayburn House Office Building.
